data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Dependence (Scientific Preference Depends on Biological Analogy for Coherence). The problem asserts that the coherence of scientific preference (as non-inductive) is dependent on the biological analogy; without the model of blind variation and selective retention, the concept of 'corroboration without induction' collapses into irrationalism. Refuted If: It is shown that scientific preference can be fully grounded in logical pragmatism or social epistemology without any reference to biological evolution, proving the analogy is heuristic rather than foundational.
